# A checked-in fixture of the expected role, command, scope and pg_get_expr() text for every row in

# allowlist row is self-consistent for tools/db/verify-function-inventory.mjs check 10, so this file is what
# makes that edit show up as a diff in review. Regenerate it, and review the diff by hand, whenever a policy
# that applies to edge_actor or edge_system changes. The comparison lives in the node check, not in SQL: a
# pgTAP file cannot read a file (see the same note in verify-function-inventory.mjs check 6).
#
# Format: one JSON object per line (JSONL), one per private.edge_policy_allowlist row, ordered by
# (schema_name, table_name, policy_name). Lines starting with '#' are comments, skipped by the reader.
#
# Regenerate after any migration that adds/changes an edge policy (from a freshly-migrated database):
#   psql -At -c "SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema_name',schema_name,'table_name',table_name,
#     'policy_name',policy_name,'role_name',role_name,'command',command,'scope',scope,
#     'using_expr',using_expr,'with_check_expr',with_check_expr)::text
#     FROM private.edge_policy_allowlist
#     ORDER BY schema_name,table_name,policy_name;" >> supabase/tests/fixtures/edge_policy_exprs.txt
